Correct the ontology citation in the preserved 2026-10-17 REPAIRED_TOMBSTONE_RESOLUTION rationale (#1023): CHEBI:63041 denotes manganese(II) chloride, not disodium citrate (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/CHEBI:63041, accessed 2026-11-01). The rejection of Na2citrate is based on its two-sodium stoichiometry differing from the trisodium citrate dihydrate representative, with no replacement disodium-citrate accession asserted.
